text: Hallelu YAH! Praise, O servants of YHWH, praise the name of YHWH!
The name of YHWH be blessed, from now and even to forever!
From the rising of the sun to its coming in, praised [is] the name of YHWH!
High over all nations [is] YHWH, [and] over the heavens His glory,
who [is] like YHWH our God, being on high to dwell,
stooping down to look on the heavens and on the earth,
raising up the poor from the dust. He lifts high the needy one from the ash heap,
to make [him] sit with princes, with the princes of His people,
settling in a home the barren woman, joyful like a mother of sons. Praise YAH!
